description: This file contains the code-behind for the UserProfile ASP.NET page, responsible for displaying and managing user profile data, handling session validation, and navigation actions.

classes.name: UserProfile
classes.description: Code-behind class for the UserProfile ASP.NET page, handling page load, session validation, and navigation button events.

methods.name: Page_Load
methods.description: Handles the initial load event of the page, retrieves user data from database if session exists, otherwise redirects to login.

methods.name: homeB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Dashboard page.

methods.name: profileB_Click
methods.description: Intended to handle navigation to the user profile page but is currently commented out.

methods.name: LeaderboardB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Leaderboard page.

methods.name: logoutB_Click
methods.description: Logs out the user by redirecting to the login page.

methods.name: coursesB_Click
methods.description: Handles navigation to the Taken Courses page.
